placements.overview:
Founded in 1972, Hirachand Nemchand College of Commerce (HNCC) is a private institute. It is located in Solapur, Maharashtra. The institute is accredited with AICTE. Hirachand Nemchand College of Commerce (HNCC) provides UG and PG courses in Full Time mode. It provides 3 courses across different specialisations. Some of the courses offered at this institute include MBA/PGDM, BCA and BBA. Hirachand Nemchand College of Commerce (HNCC) fees is INR 2,24,348. The student intake for these courses is 360. Hirachand Nemchand College of Commerce (HNCC) offers these course across fields such as Business & Management Studies and IT & Software. Hirachand Nemchand College of Commerce (HNCC) offers all the campus facilities to students.

Hirachand Nemchand College of Commerce (HNCC) is an institute which offers various courses at UG and PG levels. Talking about PG level, some of the available courses include MBA/PGDM. The fee structure for the Hirachand Nemchand College of Commerce (HNCC) programmes is around INR 2,24,348.

faqs.answer: With BSc degree you are eligible for majority of non technical posts in Government (Central, State, PSU, Banks etc) where eligibility criterion is graduation degree. faqs.question: How are BCA placements at Srinivas University?
faqs.answer: BCA students can get upto 15LPA. Srinivas University has an active placement cell and a good placement record for its BCA program. Many top companies recruit students from the BCA program at Srinivas University based on their performance. The BCA program is designed to make students experts in networking, server installation and management, web servers, client-server technology, and web programming with database management. The course adopts the latest technologies into the curriculum and has a good placement record, with students getting placed during the fifth semester in leading IT companies like Infosys Technologies, Wipro, Deloitte, Accenture Technologies, and Cap Gemini, among others. The university follows a unique stage-wise campus placement conditioning process for its eligible and registered students.

reviews.review_heading: Good facilities and campus.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are very good and clean, they have hourly cleaning timings. They have many good labs. In hostels, there is good food and cleaning. The hostels are nearby the college, and there is a pickup bus to go to the hostels, they have Wi-Fi and well-maintained bathrooms.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement all the time and I see many of my seniors get a happy ending.
reviews.review_text: Excellent maintenance and health food, all staffs were helpful and nice bathroom and clean. All time hot water was available and water purifiers were there 24 hour. Staff will be there. Security was also there. It was the safest place all time, Wi-Fi was there 5G unlimited and also library.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college facilitates easy access to the library, Wi-Fi, and well-maintained classrooms. The quality of the hostel is moderate. The food quality is just fine. Medical facilities are good. They organize sports events with good standards of achievement.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with the current placements, but good faculty members and campus facilities.
reviews.review_text: We have a new campus for the ICIS department with large lab facilities. One single lab can handle 100+ students. There is a big 86-inch Samsung smart monitor in every class. Also, there are projectors and chalkboards. We have a library with digital access too. Classrooms are equipped with charging sockets and a great amount of space.

reviews.review_heading: I would not recommend anyone to get admission at Srinivas University.
reviews.review_text: There are some low-level benches and desks. The infrastructure is not worth what we pay as a college feels. There is no Wi-Fi in the beginning and it is only for limited people and for some, it will not connect. Sports and games are also not that good.

reviews.review_heading: It has a good campus.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our college are good. The hostel and the quality of food are good. There is a canteen in our college. It provides good and healthy food.

reviews.review_heading: Decent college with good infrastructure and placement, but needs a curriculum.
reviews.review_text: Campus wise high with Wi-Fi and dedicated bandwidth when it comes to labs. Well-equipped labs for each department including CSE AIML, mech, etc., are available. Special ventilated and digital with projector, smart boards are available for interactive sessions. A central library is available with a vast collection of books, e-journals, and research papers. There is separate hostel for boys and girls with 2/3 sharing.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Srinivas University.
reviews.review_text: I like to work on computers and develop software so I have chosen this course. We had mini-projects each semester which enhanced our developing software skills and also it was easy when we reached the final project of academics. I was not staying in the college hostel however, had a few friends who were staying in the college hostel the hostel was a little away from the college say 3 km where the college bus would drop them off morning, and evening to the place and there was Srinivas hostel.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure, a good library, and qualified teachers. I am fully satisfied with it.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best universities.

reviews.review_text: Classrooms and labs are good. Rest is all waste in this college. There is no canteen, no medical facility, no sports and games, etc. The infra is good but do not fall for it. It is just a makeup for the college. Nothing is good in this college.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is very good.
reviews.review_text: We have facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. The hostel infrastructure is very good, and they serve North Indian and South Indian food. The warden is very caring about the students.

reviews.review_heading: This college is very good.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a good infrastructure. Wi-Fi is enabled in the college. We have a library and lab. The food served in the hostel is good. They serve both South and North Indian food, and the hostel warden is caring towards the students. We have medical facilities too.

reviews.review_heading: The teaching is good, but infrastructure and co-curricular activities are poor.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very bad here. The infrastructure is not satisfying to students and faculty members. Classrooms are good, but labs and Wi-Fi facility are poor. Instruments are not in condition, and students suffer during exams. There is no proper food and canteen. Our college doesn't give priority to sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good course and very helpful for students.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility, lab and classroom are available for our course. The quality of the food served is not good. However, apart from that, other things are better. The quality of the mess is better, and the hostel rooms are well ventilated and well distributed. They have attached bathrooms, and sports facilities are available. There are also medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very effective course.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. Classrooms are very good. The library room is not so huge, but it has some knowledgeable books. It has 3 hostel buildings. Food served in the hostel is not so good. Water supply is not available all the time. Medical facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: Experienced teacher with good infrastructure and surroundings.
reviews.review_text: The facility like Wi-Fi is there in the college as well as a proper laboratory. Also, the classroom is very good for study and also suitable for a student's mind. Let's talk about the hostel, the condition is very good and there are 3 major hostels in the college, one is for girls and two hostels for the boys.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, an average college with good faculty and placements.
reviews.review_text: Library and laboratories are very good. Only volleyball and basketball courts are available in the college play ground which is a bit harsh for cricket and football lovers. Canteen is much improved in the last year. Hostel is not in campus. There are certain problems in the hostel regarding the quality of food and sometimes the availability of water. Only you can south indian food in the hostel menu which isn't suitable for north indian students. Classrooms are organised. You can use free Wi-Fi ...

reviews.review_heading: Good, but not good as well.
reviews.review_text: The classroom was good. The library is good. There are no medical facilities, no sports, no games, Wi-Fi works very slow. I don't know much about the hostel, but my friend used to stay in the hostel. She used to tell that hostel food is not good. The same food will be provided for three times also.

reviews.review_heading: The colleges had really good infrastructure, good placements, and support.
reviews.review_text: I studied at these colleges. They gave me placement and internship opportunities. 98% of students got placed in their jobs, and I think everyone is doing well. In college, we learned many life lessons. Most students got internships from these colleges.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty members and decent placements, but it need better industry exposure.
reviews.review_text: College offered Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, a good library, and decent labs for B.B.M. Hostel facilities were decent and shared rooms. Food in the mess was average but hygienic. Canteen was better. Medical help was available. Sports and indoor games were also available.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus life, supportive teachers, decent placements, but scope for improvement in facilities.
reviews.review_text: Bangalore City College had Wi-Fi, labs, library, good classrooms, hostel with basic amenities. Sports facilities were decent. Food and water quality in mess could vary. Medical aid was available. The campus was clean and well-connected with friendly staff and regular cultural activities.

reviews.review_heading: Yes, good placement and really good infrastructure .
reviews.review_text: It is a very big college. Every classroom library hostel is good. Mess, canteen, sports and medical facilities are good. We have got the best labs, classrooms, Wi-Fi etc. We have sports days. Infrastructure is beautiful.

The university offers courses for all levels of study, including undergraduate, postgraduate, doctorate, post-graduate Diploma, undergraduate Diploma fellowship, Certificate and super speciality. The flagship courses of MUHS Nashik are B.Sc. And B.A. MS B.Sc. Course is offered across three specialisations and further into various disciplines through the Department of Medical and Nursing. The NEET UG entrance exam is used at MUHS for admission to the B.Sc. (Nursing) programme; however, other B.Sc. Specialisations may have different admissions procedures. college_info.intro:
Alliance College of Management & Hotel Management offers courses in UG, PG, Diploma, and PG Diploma levels in full-time mode. The institute offers courses such as PG Diploma, MBA and BBA popularly. The respective courses are offered on the basis of merit and valid entrance exam scores.
For admission to MBA, candidates must qualify graduation with a minimum aggregate of 50% and secure valid scores in accepted entrance exams such as APICET. Moreover, the duration of these courses varies from 1 year to 3 years. The courses include BBA, MBA, Executive MBA, P.G. Diploma In Business Management, P.G. Diploma In Retail Management and others. Below are the Alliance College of Management & Hotel Management popular programmes:

fees_and_eligibility.overview: offers a wide range of programmes to students at the and levels. The college is mainly concerned with streams such as Business & Management Studies and Hospitality & Travel. At the UG level, the college offers courses such as BBA, UG Diploma and BHMTT. At the PG level, the college offers courses such as MBA/PGDM, Executive MBA/PGDM and PG Diploma. Alliance Institute Of Hotel Management courses are offered to students in offline mode. Further, the fees structure for Alliance Institute Of Hotel Management courses stands around INR 54,000.

college_info.intro:
ITS Engineering College offers courses such as BTech and MBA as popular courses. The College offers them in full-time mode for a duration varying from 2 years to 4 years. Furthermore, the College offers admission to these courses on the basis of merit and an entrance exam. Therefore, candidates must secure a minimum aggregate of 45% to 50% in in Class 12 for admission to BTech and 50% in graduation for admission to MBA.
Candidates must also secure valid scores in accepted entrance exams such as JEE Main, UPTAC, CUET-PG and other equivalent exams to secure admission at the ITS Engineering College. Furthermore, the College offers these courses with a fee structure including a tuition fee ranging from INR 1.3 Lakh to INR 4.2 Lakh. The ITS Engineering College also provides placements through the panel of top recruiters, along with placement assistance.

admission_process.title: ITS Engineering College Admission 2025

paragraphs: ITS Engineering College admission is ongoing. Students can pursue two programmes i.e.,MBAandBTech,in the fields of Management and Technology, respectively at the institute. Additionally, the institute also offers lateral entry for the BTech programme. The admission process of the institute is conducted online.ITS Engineering Collegeprovides the course in affiliation with Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU). Students seeking admission must meet the admission criteria prior to applying. Interested candidates can read the following article to learn about the courses, eligibility, selection criteria, fee, and admission process of the institute.

ITS Engineering College course admissionisentrance-based. The eligibility for various courses at the institute is the last qualifying examination, i.e., Class 12 for the UG programme and a bachelor's degree for the PG programme. The selection of candidates is done based on merit or entrance exam scores. Students are offered Major and Minor degree in BTech across multiple specialisations. Students can refer to the table below to know about the eligibility and selection criteria for theITS Engineering College courses:

ITS Engineering College admission procedureis inclusive of several steps, including application, shortlisting, counselling, and admission confirmation. Students looking to apply for the programmes offered at the institute are required to appear for the course-specific entrance exam and fulfil the eligibility criteria before applying. The admission process for the institute can be done both online and offline. Interested students can follow the step-wiseITS Engineering College admission process:
Step 1: ITS Engineering College Application Process

The application process for ITS Engineering College varies as per the course selected by the students. Students wishing to apply for the BTech course need to apply and appear for the JEE Main exam. For the MBA course, students are required to appear for the CUET PG exam. For direct admissions, once the results are out, students can apply on the official website of the institute.
For admissions through JEE Mains or UPSEE, selected students need to visit the registrar's office with the allotment letter issued by the respective counselling in favour of ITS Engineering College.
Step 2:ITS Engineering College Selection Process

ITS Engineering College shortlists the candidates for its course based on several factors. The institute considers scores obtained by the candidates in JEE Main (for BTech) and CUET PG (for MBA). For students applying through direct admissions, the institute may conduct a round of written tests or personal interviews to shortlist the candidate.
Step 3: ITS Engineering College Counselling
Once the entrance exam results are out, students applying on an entrance basis are required to participate in the UPTAC/ UPSEE counselling for seat allotment.
Step 4:ITS Engineering College Admission Confirmation

Post the seat allotment, students must pay the fee as per the fee structure of the institute. The fee can be paid either through online mode or through a Demand Draft drawn in favour of “ITS Engineering College, payable at Greater Noida". Further procedures will be conducted in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Really worth college life.

admission_process.title: VIET Visakhapatnam Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: VIET Visakhapatnam admissionis both merit and entrance-based. The institute considers scores in AP EAMCET, AP ICET, AP PGECE, etc. scores for admission to specific programmes.Visakha Institute of Engineering and Technologyoffers courses at UG and PG levels in Management, Computer Applications and Engineering streams. The institute offers programmes in affiliation with JNTUGV Vizianagaram. Aspirants are offered admission through OAMDC or Online Admissions Module for Degree Colleges in Andhra Pradesh in BCA and BBA courses. Interested candidates can apply for the accepted entrance exam and the preferred course online.

VIET offers seven courses in full-time mode at UG and PG levels. The programmes are offered in various specialisations. Aspirants can check below the key highlights related toVIET Visakhapatnam admission:
Particulars
VIET Admission Highlights 2025
Mode of study
Programmes Offered

https://www.viet.edu.in/

VIET admissions are primarily entrance-based. The institute considers the merit of the aspirants in the last qualifying exam for BBA and BCA programmes. Candidates must fulfil the eligibility requirements to apply for a course. Below are popularVIET Visakhapatnam coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:

Currently, the admissions are open for all the VIET courses. Candidates are selected for admission based on their scores in an entrance test or a qualifying exam. The institute considers state-level entrance exams for admission. Below are the steps to get a seat in the institute:
Step 1: VIET Visakhapatnam Application Process 2025

Candidates must first apply for the accepted entrance exam or AP OAMDC portal as required by the course. After completion of the selection process, candidates also need to fill out the admission form on the institute's website for the preferred programme.
Step 2: Selection

VIET Visakhapatnam selects candidates for BTech and MTech courses based onAP EAMCETandAP PGECET, respectively. For admission to MBA, candidates must score well in AP ICET. Besides, the selection for BBA and BCA courses is based on merit of the aspirants in the last qualifying exam. The institute also considersAP POLYCETfor admission to diploma courses.
Step 3: Counselling & Seat Allotment

Aspirants need to further apply for state-level entrance exam counselling accepted for the applied course. Once the seat is allotted to aspirants who have appeared for the entrance exam, they need to fill out the admission form on the institute's website. For BBA and BCA, candidates are offered seats via OAMDC. Selected candidates need to pay theVIET feeto confirm their seats.

reviews.review_heading: There is good infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: There is Wi-Fi in our classrooms. There is a good infrastructure. It's a campus with 5-6 blocks each. Our college has good nature. Hostel has washing machines, and in a single room approximately 42 members can stay. Weekly once students can wash clothes in the washing machines. There are good facilities. But rooms are short to survive. There are 2 wardens who take care of the students.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is very good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and architecture in our college are very nice. Labs and classrooms are very well-painted. All facilities are available at all times. The computer lab is very good. Medical facilities are available for all members on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Visakha Institute of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is average but not bad. The labs contain machinery but some of them are presently not in working condition. The college has a canteen available in the campus itself. There is a playground in the college for cricket, kabaddi, and many other games.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the college VIET.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Visakha Institute of Engineering and Technology is very beautiful and attractive. The facilities provided in labs included with fast Wi-Fi facility as well as in classrooms. Coming to hostel, it's just budget-friendly, this is not a hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Visakha Institute of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Visakha Institute of Engineering and Technology is very cool and calm. The facilities available for our course we have the best labs with Wi-Fi facilities. Classrooms are clean and maintained. We have a big central library with a silent environment.

reviews.review_heading: The college review of VIET.
reviews.review_text: The facilities offered here are Wi-Fi, labs with the best equipment, and classrooms that are maintained nicely. Hostel is just budget-friendly, they charge only for the food we consume. It's not a hostel, they made classrooms into hostel rooms. There are six rooms in each room and 40 students to stay.

reviews.review_heading: Good in infrastructure and teaching facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college and campus environment is good. Labs facilities are just okay and the classrooms are also good for studying. Good library facilities are available in our college for learning semesters. It is quite difficult to stay in a hostel because of less maintenance and the sports facilities are also not so good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the college VIET.
reviews.review_text: The hostel of Visakha Institute of Engineering and Technology is budget-friendly. Here we stay 40 members per room. It consists of 6 big rooms. These are not rooms. These are classrooms. They converted into a hostel. Wi-Fi facility is very nice.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Visakha Institute of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Visakha Institute of Engineering and Technology is very nice. There are so many labs with high network connections. The hostel is just budget-friendly. The hostel is okay for students who can adjust to 40 members in each room. It is not charging for a stay and it only charges for food.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Visakha Institute of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is better. Wi-Fi is available in every block. Labs are well-maintained and good. Classrooms are neat, clean, and well-maintained. A big central library is also available on the campus. Hostel food is very delicious.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the college.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are nice and friendly behavior in all department. College has a Wi-Fi facility and labs, a Chemistry lab, a Physics lab, an Engineering workshop, and an IT workshop. There are two libraries. The hostel is not good and the food quality in the hostel is the worst.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the college in which I am going to complete my graduation.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good. Classrooms have good air conditioning in the B.Tech campus. Outside experience is also good to hill and have fun with it. Overall, it is a good experience with the infrastructure of the college with all factors.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Mountains are located around the college, so it makes the college environment very beautiful. Wi-Fi is available. Labs are nice. Classrooms are also very nice. A central library is available. Coming to the hostel, it is not a hostel. They converted classrooms into a hostel. It consists of six big rooms. 40 students stay in each room, so it's your wish to join the hostel or not.

reviews.review_heading: Expect the future is better here.
reviews.review_text: The environment at the college, both outside and inside the classrooms are good. Still the hostels were terrible, with 30 to 40 students per room. This made it very difficult especially during the summer months. The college also lacked proper facilities for students living in the hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied in teaching and satisfied in labs, hostel.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and the labs environment was just okay to our college. The labs are quite less maintenance and it was difficult to do the experiments. The library facilities are good and the classroom facilities are good. The sports and the canteen facilities are less and the hostel maintenance is also okay only.

review_summary.college_name: IMU Kolkata Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Marine Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: One of the best colleges for marine engineering with a high placement rate.

content.Placements: The placement of the Indian Maritime University Kolkata campus is very good. For the 2024 pass-out batch, the placement was around 98%, and for the 2025 pass-out batch, it was around 97%. In this campus, you can easily get a placement if you don't have supplements. The overall placement is very good and top-notch.
content.Infrastructure: The overall infrastructure of the Indian Maritime University Kolkata campus is quite good, covering 33 acres of land. The infrastructure of the new academic building is very good. All classes are fully air-conditioned, and the labs have various equipment. Our campus has Asia's largest marine workshop.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Marine Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: One of the best colleges that offers a degree in marine engineering and best placements.

content.Placements: For the last batch, it was around 97%, and for 2024 passout, it was 98%. The placements are best from here. The lowest rate of placement occurred in 2021 due to covid. Otherwise, the placements are above 95% every year. Placements for girls start from 1st year and for boys 2nd year onwards.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has an outstanding academic building and fully centralized and air-conditioned. But in hostels Wi-Fi is not available. The menu of food is alright but taste is okay, not great. There are no hygiene issues. There are supportive seniors and great atmosphere for sports and extracurricular activities. We have the largest marine workshop in Southeast Asian, and the labs are great.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Marine Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: College is creating legacies.

content.Placements: The batch that is going to pass out this year got 96.35% of students placed in top companies like NYK Line, MOL, Chevron, Wallem, Torm Tankers, etc., with a minimum package of 900$ per month. They will be joining the ship as an engine cadet. College is best.
content.Infrastructure: Express Wi-Fi is available all over campus. The library is open all day except Sunday. It has Asia's largest marine workshop with engines namely Yanmar and Allen. It has air-conditioned classrooms with projector and simulators. Lift facilities are available all over the campus. It is filled with greenery and nature all around. Hostels are also very good with a cafeteria and canteen. The best part is the food which we get from a mess.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Marine Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The best marine institute IMU-KC.

content.Placements: The recent batch of 2025 which has been passed out was placed 94% of its total strength to date. The highest package offered was 1400 dollars and the minimum was 800 dollars with top recruiting companies such as NYK lies, Chevron, Pacific Basin, Torm Tankers, Fleets Management, Wallem, and many more. The cadets passed out from the college are offered the rank of trainee and marine engineer onboard.
content.Infrastructure: College is fully nature-friendly with residential-type courses. Smart labs and library for the students to enhance tier expertise. Simulator labs and VR labs are also top-notch. The mess menu and quality of food slightly coincide with that of NDA. Basketball courts, volleyball courts, badminton courts, football, hockey, and many sports are also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Marine Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It's a hard job, but if you get used to it, you will make a good living out of it.

content.Placements: Our placement rate is quite steady with 99% of the cadets being placed every year. The highest package offered is Rs. 1200 $ per month and the average is around 600-700 $ per month. Top recruiting companies include Chevron, Shell, Scorpio, Dynacom, etc. There are internship opportunities for every cadet from the 2nd year onwards. We get in as a 5th engineer onboard where we learn how to deal with the job.
content.Infrastructure: There are air-conditioned classrooms with projectors and Wi-Fi facilities in each of them. There's a separate library where Cadets can go study on their own before the exams. There are mess facilities in each of the hostels. The quality of the food is decent. Almost every sport from football to table tennis is being played on the campus. There is a separate medical facility inside the campus.

hostel_campus.college_name: IMU Kolkata Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description:
The hostel has a multi-level formation. On the first level - the wings are divided into 10 Sadans (houses). These "Sadans" are named after famous scientists - Bose, Diesel, Edison, Faraday, Froude, Marconi, Newton, Parson, Raman, Rankin. On the second level- the hostels are further divided into the junior hostel, senior hostel for final year students and east & west wings for 2nd & 3rd-year students.
 
The girls' hostel is a welcome addition to the existing infrastructure of the college. Sonali Banerjee - the first woman marine engineer of Asia - who first occupied this hostel in 1995. The hostel is adjacent to the officer's quarters and is equipped with various amenities.

reviews.review_heading: This college is best for placement and also for environment.
reviews.review_text: Everything is available in the college. Everything is good in the mess hostel, they cook delicious food, take care of the hostel, and keep it clean for the students. Games are also available in college for your curricular activities, you can come.

reviews.review_heading: Really good college with a nice infrastructure. The teaching staff is well-trained.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms were well-furnished and ventilated. Labs were equipped with every instrument and device. The hostel rooms had adequate space, and the mess and canteen served decent quality food. The sports team of Maharishi University was good in several sports, such as cricket, and a big ground was available for the students to play.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good for the unregular students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college and classrooms are good. Some classrooms are equipped. Students have access to comfortable hostel accommodation which offers sanitary facilities. It has less infrastructure and few technical facilities. Labs are old, and they are not upgraded. The college has two buildings, an academic block with classrooms, labs, and faculty rooms. The hostel is medium. The canteen is not good.

reviews.review_heading: Good education with experienced faculty, but bad placement.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are not that good. Labs are not the best, they are not modernized. Classrooms are good, and they have AC. The library is big, but not all books are available in the library related to my course. The quality and taste of the food is good. There are lots of sports available, like badminton, cricket, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Maharishi University College.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms, libraries, and labs were good, and Wi-Fi was also available in these areas, but they did not share the password with students. The hostel facilities were good, and the food in the mess was not that great, but the canteen food was quite tasty. Several sports games were available for both boys and girls.

reviews.review_heading: Journey of life to find our strength and weakness.
reviews.review_text: There are labs for performing practicals. We have 2 libraries. One is a central library and another is a humanity library. The central library is large. The college provides computer labs. We can issue books with the help of the library card. It is valid for 1 week. Wi-Fi is also available but everyone doesn't have their access.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college compared to other colleges nearby. It has value for money.
reviews.review_text: In my department, we have got good enough facilities in classrooms and canteen area. Hotel facilities are not good. In the canteen, there are far better services. Sports, games, and events are conducted. The mess is average.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college, faculty, placements, and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided in the college are outstanding such as a laboratory, a library, and a playground for students to play and relax. Classrooms and washrooms are well-maintained keeping an eye on hygiene and cleanliness. Not only the university, but the hostel area is also well-maintained and clean. The food provided is also well-cooked in the mess with proper hygiene.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Maharishi University of Information Technology.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is quite good. They opt for renewable sources of energy, as they installed solar panels on the roof of college. Classrooms are good, but the seating can be improved, as it is slightly comfortable to sit on a chair. Overall, infrastructure is good.

reviews.review_heading: An average college, and it is the last option to choose.
reviews.review_text: In terms of infrastructure, both the hostel and college are quite good. There is a happy and ragging-free campus with almost all amenities. The library is available for self-study. The food quality at the mess is not up to the mark, but it is manageable. Overall, our college has good infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: It is a bad college of Lucknow .
reviews.review_text: The facilities and information available for my course are too bad and there is no support for Wi-Fi. The labs are fully equipped, the classroom is not clean, and the library was built after my batch. There are no books available in the library and the quality of food available in the canteen is too bad.

reviews.review_heading: Private university (MUIT Lucknow)
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good for students. There is a different hostel for girls and boys. As per your comfort and choice, you can choose either a three-seater or two-seater room. Rooms are well-furnished, and security is also good. Mess food is fine. If we talk about college infrastructure, it's very large and beautiful.

reviews.review_heading: MAHARISHI UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY, LUCKNOW
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is really eye catching. It have well furnished classrooms. There is auditorium, hall, labs, libraries and canteen in the college. Hostel is provided to the students who is not native to this place or they have a need of it . It's also good and the food is also average.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text:
There is a digital classroom with air conditioning. 
Wi-Fi is available at the college. 
Labs are systematically available with proper chemicals and equipment. 
The quality of food in the hostel is good; the canteen is there in the college; medical facilities are there; sports and games are also there .

reviews.review_heading: An average college for the CSE course.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure available for our course at this college was good. Facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, hostel, halls, auditorium, projectors, etc., were available for the students. The library and labs of the college were well-stocked with the necessary equipment and books. Multiple sports facilities were available for the students.

review_summary.college_name: Gulzar Group of Institutes Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Very good and beautiful colleges are situated in Khanna. Good study facilities and infrastructure.

content.Placements: Lots of placement cells and facilities for students. Every year, so many got placed from Gulzar Group of Institutes. The companies coming for placements are so good and offer good income for our future. Most of the companies like Infosys, Allunumeric, etc., visit the campus.
content.Infrastructure: My course is BCA and it's so good in my college. Every week, we attended the labs for our practical knowledge learning. The staff is so talented that they provide us with better and good course knowledge. I'm also a hosteler, and the hostel is so clear and beautiful.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely amazing staff work performance, not only calculated by studies.

content.Placements: Practical knowledge and coding skills were offered in this course. Recruiting companies were Accenture, Jio, Wipro, Quantum, Zun Pulse, Amazon, Solitaire Infosys, Qspiders, Vprotech, TCS, Cognizant, Microsoft, Google, Ceasefire, HCL Technologies, Maantech Technologies, Airtel, Vodafone, and Walmart.
content.Infrastructure: Our college had fully furnished labs, classrooms, and proper arrangements for chemistry and physical instruments. All classrooms had AC. Cold and hot water facilities were available according to the weather. Hostel fee was affordable. Sports day celebration was held. Gaming activities were held for two weeks. Mess and canteen food were well-made and clean. It had affordable prices in canteens. Medical facilities were available. Every month, a body checkup was done. Blood donation camps were there. All types of books were available in libraries. Well-made washrooms were available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: They provided the best facilities for their students.

content.Placements: According to me, 90% of students got jobs in different companies. They earned a good income because the GGI teachers taught very well. Some students went abroad for their further studies. At that time, I was confused about which course would be best for me, so JP sir suggested I do the BCA course. Now I am an employee of Ganga Acrowool Limited Company.
content.Infrastructure: They provided many facilities like labs, AC classrooms, a library, and a clean environment. I liked their facilities. They also provided neat and clean food in the mess. Medical facilities, sports, and games were also available. They provided a better internet.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Overall, for someone who wants to study seriously, this college is a good place to study.

content.Placements: The students with placement are usually around 75 to 99 percent, and students easily get scholarships. Companies like Intel, Google, and Amazon visit. This course offers roles like data analyst, web developer, and software developer. It also provides regular hackathons and events for the students.
content.Infrastructure: For this course, all the faculty members, like the library and the labs, are always open, and teachers are also available for help. The whole campus is Wi-Fi covered provides free high-speed and secure internet connectivity, and also provides specific emails from the college for better management.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: My college is the best. All facilities are provided to students and teachers are good.

content.Placements: 70% of students get placed in our course. The highest package of my college is 10 LPA and the lowest package is 3 LPA. Different companies visit our college for placements. In my college, the top courses offered are the B.Tech (CSE) and the Diploma course. 80% of students get internships in different companies.
content.Infrastructure: My college provides all facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, comfortable classrooms, and the library. The mess food is of average quality. It completely provides medicines, sports, and games. My college hostel facilities are average, and students do not easily get rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty is good. Good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is actually very good, the classrooms are also good, our college also has a big library, and the labs are also well-maintained. Hostel infra is also good, food quality was also very nice, and we also have proper sports infra. Our college also conducts sports and games every year, where every student from each batch participates and competes.

reviews.review_heading: Good teaching staff for 1st year.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is good. The buildings are clean and provide a very neat environment for students to study. We have several sports on campus. We can play sports by using our IDs. There is even one subject for sports. Everything seems okay with the infrastructure. There are two hostels available for girls and boys.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Pune District Education Association's College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is good. The buildings are clean and provide a very neat environment for students to study. We have several sports on campus. We can play sports by using our IDs. There is even one subject for sports. Everything seems okay with the infrastructure. There are two hostels available for girls and boys.

reviews.review_heading: College infrastructure is very nice and facilities are also nice, but placements are little less.
reviews.review_text: Labs are neat and clean, computers are properly working, and each one has an individual desktop during particals. Labs have Wi-Fi connection. Library has multiple books, for example, competitive exam books. Classrooms have projectors. Hostel facilities are very nice, and the canteen food is also nice. Sports equipment is also provided, and there is a 5 to 6-day sports day.

reviews.review_heading: It's not that bad, but not that good. Placements are there, and infrastructure is also good.
reviews.review_text: It's good that the environment is also good around the campus, but there is no Wi-Fi available in the college. There is a huge ground, the canteen food is also nice, but it doesn't taste that. There are multiple sports options, and medical facilities are provided.

reviews.review_heading: I would say the college is at a moderate level.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure was good, no doubt about infrastructure. Building was modern with moderate level of location. There was Wi-Fi in all labs and classrooms. There were 3 hostels associated with the college. Hostels had food included in their package. No medical benefits were available.

reviews.review_heading: It is satisfying if students are planning to do a master's later and just want a bachelor's degree.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good. It has a neat and clean environment. There is a well-equipped library and an e-library system. We get reference books needed for the syllabus and self learning. There are several spots on campus for quiet study, even some for sports, especially cricket and volleyball.

reviews.review_heading: The faculty here is knowledgeable and supportive. They are always ready to help students.
reviews.review_text: We have a library in our college, which is big enough. We have a ground on which we can play various games. There is a canteen in our college which serves healthy and good food.

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: Mess food is awesome good quantity and quality food available at cheaper rates. You don't get to eat the same things you get a variety and good food. Hostels are not up to that mark like that of home but they are good for an engineering college student. Good net facilities are available. Sports equipment and ground are near from hostel. Also, the hostel has 24 hour water and electricity supply.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of its faculty members and principal of our college.
reviews.review_text: The campus has big infrastructure. There are various labs for students to perform and complete the practicals or projects. Labs have Wi-Fi with fully access to search various types of projects. College has a big library to read books or for study also and has classrooms for lectures. The quality of the hostel is excellent. Mess food is very good as compared to other colleges. There are all kinds of sports organized by the college.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very good. Having experienced teachers, good campus, and average package is 4 LPA.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good having a library for students in college. We also have Wi-Fi-enabled labs and library. In the hostel, there is very good environment. We have Wi-Fi and water for drinking. There is a clean canteen for food. There is also a ground for playing football and other sports.

content.Placements: Around 30% of students got placed. The highest salary package offered is 7 LPA, and the average salary package offered is 2.5 LPA. Students need to search for internships individually. College don't provide internships. College does not guarantee job placements. However, college may provide high packages for 1 or 2 students.
content.Infrastructure: Minimum sports facilities are available. Canteen and lab are available, and the college provides Wi-Fi and digital boards in classrooms. College provides low facilities and charges more fees. College prioritizes sports and maintains decipline.

individual_reviews.title: Sharing my review for the experience at IMRT Nashik 2014-16 batch. Overall Rating for IMRT 3.75/5.

content.Placements: No Placements for HR. Rest of the facilities provided by the management was quite good. The overall freedom and campus atmosphere depends upon the nature of Director as he is the sole ruler for the Institute. The second year for our MBA 2015-16 was the worst year ever of college life. We experienced the Jail life .
content.Infrastructure: General Infrastructure is well good. Ambient Air. Huge Corridors. Presentation Facility for Classroom. Allover cleanliness is maintained. Library facility provided for students is very attractive and fulfilled with the relevant books and research papers.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: My review about this college.

content.Placements: Placements and job opportunities are very good in this college. Companies start to visit for placement drives in the 3rd semester only. There are open campus drives, pool campus and closed campus drives for the placements for students. Well number of companies visit the college. The starting of the package is indeed low around 3-4 LPA, but it is good for those who want job experience along with some money. Whereas the highest package goes to 10 LPA. The college provides internship opportunities to the students. The college has made contacts with various companies that provide internship (paid and unpaid).

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: My Review About This College .

content.Placements: Placement Offers were good enough the packages are pretty good though. They range from 3-4.5 Lacs P. A, for most marketing placements. Placement department invites many compnoes but very few joins in actual. No big shots have yet visited the campus only local companies attend the campus interview. And average package offered range from 1.9 to 3.5 few of the top companies like TCS, Jio finance, etc. Visit the campus provided package range 4 LPA to 10 LPA. There were few companies which came to provide internship to students. No stipend was offered some time but it's gain experience.
